Hi Ben — thanks for the speedy follow-up. We tried adding the ICS to the shared mailbox but the web client still shows a blank join button and a "Meet link removed by admin" note. Our IT says that auto-stripped buttons happen when calendar events come from non-verified senders and they block Meet/Join widgets for security.

We were able to join manually with the meeting ID and passcode you pasted, but it took a few minutes while the host authenticated the shared account. For future calls it would help if the invite includes a short host-auth note at the top (e.g., "If joining from a shared mailbox, use Meeting ID and passcode; host may need to claim host role on join").

Also, Neptune IT asked whether Redwood can white-label the Zoom domain for enterprise customers or provide an SSO-signed calendar invite so embedded buttons survive their filters. If not, a persistent fallback (meeting ID & dial-in in the top of the invite body + ICS) is what we'll rely on.

Thanks — demo was great and the team had useful questions. Next step: can we share the recording and the version of the slide deck that includes the model perf numbers?

Best,
Alicia
Head of Product, Neptune Analytics
